nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Docker build context exclusion list that prevents .venv, .git, __pycache__, .env, and other non-essential files from being sent to the Docker daemon, keeping images free of local development and credential artifacts.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Single-stage Docker image based on python:3.13-slim that installs application dependencies, runs as a non-root user (uid 10001) with IST timezone, and uses a no-op smoke-test CMD that compose or Kubernetes overrides with the real command.
nodes.languageNotes: Single-stage (not multi-stage); requirements.txt is copied and installed before the application source so code-only edits do not invalidate the pip layer.

nodes.name: docker-compose.yml
nodes.summary: Compose orchestration file defining five services — Postgres 16 + pgvector, MinIO object storage, a write-once bucket provisioner, an Alembic migration runner, and a pytest runner — mirroring the intended cloud/Kubernetes deployment topology.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a YAML anchor (x-app) to share build context, image name, and environment config between migrate and test services without repetition.

nodes.name: db
nodes.summary: Postgres 16 + pgvector database service bound to 127.0.0.1:5433, with a pg_isready health check and a persistent pgdata volume, providing the primary relational and vector store for the equity knowledge system.

nodes.name: blob
nodes.summary: MinIO S3-compatible object storage service pinned by digest and bound to 127.0.0.1:9000, acting as the local stand-in for cloud blob storage that holds write-once raw source files keyed by content hash.

nodes.name: blob-init
nodes.summary: One-shot MinIO client container that creates the equity-raw and equity-raw-test buckets with object lock and 36500-day GOVERNANCE retention, ensuring stored source bytes are immutable and cannot be deleted.

nodes.name: migrate
nodes.summary: One-shot service using the app image to run `alembic upgrade head`, applying all pending schema migrations before any application workload starts; mirrors the Kubernetes Job / init-container pattern.

nodes.name: test
nodes.summary: Pytest runner service (activated via the 'test' profile) using the app image to execute the full test suite with fail-fast mode and short tracebacks, sharing the same EQUITY_* environment as the application.
